description: Everything an agent needs to ground a scene, NPC, quest or prompt in a real place and moment, in one call: the spatial identity with the tile card's full context (meanings, story catalyst, imagery, inspiration prompt, story function and archetype, spread templates, geometry, navigation, correspondences, names in six languages), the time portal with the moment card's full context, the eight neighbouring tiles, approximate sun altitude/daylight and moon phase, and a structured narrative seed ready to hand to a model. No text is generated. Deterministic for a given input and "at", with a receipt hash. Price: $0.02 USDC per call after 25 free calls per day.

_payment.description: x402 v2 payment: base64 PaymentPayload, as you would send in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Only needed after the free allowance is used.

at.description: Optional UTC instant, e.g. 2026-11-02T08:30Z. Defaults to now.

timezoneId.description: Optional IANA timezone. If omitted, it is looked up from the coordinate (falls back to solar time).

name: location_context
title: Location context (place + time + sky + story seed)
